## What changed

Summarize the focused vertical slice. For any new internal parameter, trace its
path to resolved score or renderer, PCM, truthful evidence, and a future decision.

## Automated quality evidence

- Engine revision and quality-policy version:
- Canonical checkpoint(s) and private fixture provenance:

Write “Not applicable” for non-musical changes. For a foundational slice whose
required evaluator does not exist yet, write “Unavailable,” name the missing
gate, and do not claim automated qualification.

## Validation

- [ ] `swift test`
- [ ] `swift build -c release --product AutoTechno`
- [ ] Deterministic plan, evidence, decision, state, and PCM remain intact where applicable
- [ ] Candidate/correction counts and controller behavior remain bounded
- [ ] Real-time callback and future-boundary constraints remain intact where applicable
- [ ] No alternate runtime, renderer, profile, or user-facing engine selector was added
- [ ] No generated WAVs, reference audio, build products, credentials, personal information, or machine-specific paths are included
